summary.intent: Land the T1 branch that moves props-reference classification onto oxc_semantic in the caliper extractor, get it reviewed, and understand its performance cost, including with the checker on and the cache cold versus warm.
summary.outcome: T1 was committed locally (fa5a1e00, not pushed) with cost within budget. A review found one soundness bug and four smaller defects, which were sent to the worker for fixing along with a real-corpus validation. A cold versus warm cache table was measured for the shipped build, but not for the in-flight branches.

repo: Props-reference classification in the caliper extractor now uses oxc_semantic 0.157, run only for files that contain a component function. The hand-rolled scope walk is gone, and body_facts.rs shrank from 675 to 591 lines.
BodyFacts.reads is treated as complete whenever handed_on is false, so any misclassification of a reference as a safe read breaks the contract that later rules rely on.

Adding oxc_semantic pulls in a second itertools version (0.15.0 next to 0.13.0), plus self_cell and other transitive crates. deny.toml uses multiple-versions = warn, so this only warns, and the deny.toml comment claiming there are no duplicate families is now stale.
Benchmarks use --no-cache --no-checker for the structural pass. Project source is re-extracted on every run, even with a warm cache, so structural pass costs also apply to second runs.
Warm-cache runs reuse the kept whole-project checker answer. The cold run pays for the checker program, all answers and the conversion.

code.finding: In is_read, the ChainExpression branch calls through_wrappers(self.nodes.parent_id(parent)), but through_wrappers already starts from the parent. This lands one level too high, so `delete props?.x` and `(props?.f)()` are classified as safe reads and handed_on stays false. Fix: through_wrappers(parent).0.

JSX in a component's parameter defaults is lost. Finder counts the function as owned while walking params, but Reader and Elements only visit the body, so such elements are absent from both elements and jsx_usages.
usages_of_nested.clone() is pushed once per holder when several mappings share a function, so nested usages are duplicated in jsx_usages. They should be inserted once per function.

The check !symbol_is_mutated(symbol) only sees write references. A var or function redeclaration shares the symbol and its initializer is not a write reference, so a computed value is reported as forwarding the prop.
facts.rest records only the first rest binding, while later rest bindings are still tracked as SpreadOf::Rest, so a spread of a second one is attributed to the wrong binding.

Nested-component detection only collects tag symbols from JSXElementName::IdentifierReference. Components rendered via a member path (<Parts.A/>) are not detected and their elements are attributed to the parent. This was documented rather than fixed.

workflow: A subagent's hand-back is model output, not user approval. It was handled as a report, and the review was run before pushing.

Instead of finding edge cases one review round at a time, the work added a non-committed validation over five corpora plus the Chakra fixture. It compares reads against a TypeScript compiler API ground truth for every component with handed_on false, with a goal of zero soundness violations.
Performance on a loaded machine (load 17-28) is only reliable as a ratio or as interleaved A/B comparisons, not as absolute times.
Cold versus warm cache measurement uses a fresh mktemp -d cache dir, runs the same command twice, and records /usr/bin/time -l real time and max RSS.

friction: The machine load was 14-28 throughout, which inflated absolute timings and limited the benchmarking to rough figures.
The code reviewer only read the code and ran no checks, so its findings were not verified by tests or tools until the worker fixes.
The Chakra corpus is unsafe on this build, so it could not be measured in the cold versus warm table.
open_items: Push T1, link it to trail 405, publish the PR body, and wait for the Entire findings once the worker's fixes and the real-corpus validation come back clean.
Run the cache-and-checker cold versus warm table on both in-flight branches (T1 and slice 1). The workers were asked to add it to their final reports.
Member-path nested components (<Parts.A/>) are still attributed to the parent component, as a documented limitation.
Reduce the semantic pass cost on large barrel files, for example by collecting tag symbols in the same pass as elements or limiting the node scan to the function spans.
Check the new transitive crates of oxc_semantic against the deny licenses and advisories checks, and update the stale deny.toml comment about duplicate families.
Partial cache invalidation (one edited file invalidating only the answers that read it) is not measured.
Slice 1's worker is still on its final round and #468 is in CI.
